title: Intel® SHMEM: GPU-initiated OpenSHMEM using SYCL
problem: Communication libraries lack support for GPU-initiated operations where OpenSHMEM-style calls execute directly within GPU kernels on heterogeneous systems with GPUs and accelerators.
motivation: Modern HPC and AI applications on heterogeneous platforms require overlapping communications and computation on GPUs to achieve increased efficiency and performance.
method: Intel SHMEM embeds OpenSHMEM-style API calls directly within GPU kernels using SYCL for GPU-initiated communication. The implementation adaptively chooses between direct load/store from GPU and GPU copy engine transfers based on system configuration. Thread-collaborative extensions to OpenSHMEM are proposed to better exploit GPU parallelism strengths.
key_novelty: GPU-initiated OpenSHMEM operations directly executable from within GPU kernels via SYCL with thread-collaborative standard extensions.
contributions: Intel SHMEM library enabling GPU-aware API calls supporting GPU memory operations
GPU-initiated communication operations embedded within GPU kernels using SYCL
Thread-collaborative extensions to the OpenSHMEM standard for GPU exploitation
Adaptive optimization selecting between direct load/store and GPU copy engine transfers
